text:
alex: Quick heads-up — DeltaData POC starts Mon. They asked for: 1) $20k free credits for evaluation, 2) an enforced spend cap of $2k/month for the POC, 3) a hosted API key for dev tests, and 4) ability to test a small dedicated pool (1x GPU) + optional Private VPC peering for smoke tests. Can we provision billing project + initial hosted key this week? cc @maria

maria (SE): Which region do they want the dedicated pool in? Also do they need quota changes for embeddings vs generation?

alex (AE): They'll operate from us-west-2. Mostly text generation, some embeddings for search. Keep embeddings quota low initially. We also need rate limit ~60 req/s on the POC key.

jon (Finance): We can spin up a billing project with promo credits. Clarify: promo amount = $20,000 USD and spend cap = $2,000/month (soft cap with alerts) or hard block? For POCs we usually do SOFT caps + alerting unless legal requires hard block. Also need AE approval to apply credits.

alex (AE): I approve soft cap with email ops + slack alerts. If they request hard block later we can revisit.

jon (Finance): ok. I'll create project id `delta-poc-1769` and apply promo_credits=$20000, monthly_soft_limit=$2000, alerts at 50/80/100%. Need to know which billing contact to CC.

alex (AE): Use my contact (alex@redwood.ai) as billing contact for now. I'll forward customer PO if they send one.

billing-bot: Billing project `delta-poc-1769` created. Promo credits applied: $20,000. Spend cap mode: SOFT. Alerts configured at 50% / 80% / 100%. Hosted API key issued (masked): `poc-****-usw2`. Note: promo credits expire in 90 days.

maria (SE): Great — I can run an initial smoke suite against the hosted key once it's unmasked. For the dedicated pool, infra will need at least 48hrs to reserve capacity in us-west-2. Also: we'll need to whitelist the POC API key on the pool side for routing tests.

sanjay (Infra): Correct. For VPC peering/private tests I need the customer's VPC CIDR ranges, their public ASN (if using AWS Direct Connect) and an S3 endpoint whitelist if they plan to hit storage. Also to support KMS-wrapped keys we need their public KMS key id. Timeline: ~48–72 hours after we get network info + SAML metadata for SSO access.

alex (AE): I'll ask DeltaData for the VPC details and Okta SAML metadata. They asked whether we can do a temporary allowlist of their engineer's IP instead of full VPC peering for initial testing.

sanjay (Infra): IP allowlist is fine for a smoke window. Send ranges and we'll add to the allowlist. For production-like tests we recommend proper VPC peering.

maria (SE): Also note — if they want a pinned model variant on the dedicated pool we need to know model name + quantization preference. That affects kernel selection and capacity.

alex (AE): They want to pin to `redwood/gpt-medium-2b` (unquantized) initially, then try q4_k_mixed for cost tests.

jon (Finance): One more billing note: anyone using the hosted API key consumes from promo credits first. After promo is exhausted we will start billing the org. I'll set an automatic email to AE + finance at 90% usage.

alex (AE): Perfect. Can you also add a soft token quota of 5M tokens/day to avoid runaway tests?

jon (Finance): Done — token_quota_daily=5_000_000. We'll relax if they need more.

maria (SE): Once I run the smoke harness I'll paste a short runbook and perf numbers (latency p50/p95, token throughput) here. If dedicated pool is provisioned we can compare.

alex (AE): Thanks all. Action items: 1) jon create billing project + credits (in progress), 2) billing-bot to unmask hosted API key for SE, 3) sanjay to reserve a 1-GPU pool in us-west-2 after we get IPs/KMS, 4) alex to collect customer network + SAML metadata. I'll update this thread when I hear back from DeltaData. :thumbsup:

maria (SE): I'll queue the smoke tests — ping me when key is unmasked.

jon (Finance): Billing project notes: promo expires in 90 days, credits are non-transferable.

alex (AE): Closing loop for now — will post the customer's network info here when received.
